method: Fresh immutable Git blob copies, independently compiled using canonical unchanged scorer and pinned IDO; actual full source and complete native bodies plus four direct callees inspected.
source_abi_findings: Full retained/native22160 and22874 bodies plus complete24988,146B4 and16CF0 were independently inspected. Previously matched1B744 two-state-pointer ABI remains unchanged.

24988 has exactly11 genuine arguments: u32,u16,five u8,two u16,two u8. Its72-byte frame reads incoming stack slots+16/+20/+24 lowbytes,+28/+32 lowhalfwords,+36/+40 lowbytes; register homes confirm leading widths. The zero tenth input is actually consumed by the key-registration gate.

22160 packs all32 command bits by actual word/byte layout, adds signed-byte interval to unsigned original halfword within signed32 range, clamps0..127 and applies the external high bit. Active is set before construction and cleared even on failure; identifier, child link and external flag are reread live after the constructor.

Successful child and existing child IDs use allocated416-byte records. Parent/child linking order and optional two-pointer controller copy agree. Malformed indices and arbitrary alias/cycle safety are outside the documented valid-resource domain.

16CF0 writes six observed descriptor words and byte+24, including the24-bit length.146B4 consumes only word slot, descriptor pointer and reset byte; internal floating conversion does not imply a caller float argument. No fake fourth input is present.

22874 preserves full high-word volume extraction, unsigned low32 multiplication/subtraction and division by127; zero length deliberately wraps length-1 as native. Real playback still requires valid nonempty resource descriptors; synthetic zero-length arithmetic tests do not prove playback safety.
Post-playback info/address and flags are read live. Host tests independently pass240 child protocol cases and1280 descriptor/mode/volume/reset cases, including constructor/playback mutations.
No fake formal, keeper, padding, volatile trick, assembly or callee body; constructor O1 unpaired-HI16 error remains rejected. Both sources are complete NONMATCHs with zero match credit.
scope: Only BT05-resource-pair research paths differ from frozen stack base; no submissions or protected changes.
